summary: The XRD analysis in this paper focuses on a dry film of CsPbBr3 perovskite quantum dots (PeQDs) deposited by drop-casting from a toluene solution. The measured XRD pattern is well-fitted by a monoclinic crystalline structure, with diffraction peaks corresponding to specific monoclinic planes. No other XRD data for different samples, processing conditions, or phases are presented in the supplied figures.
experimental_variables: Sample form: dry film of PeQDs deposited by drop-casting a PeQD-in-toluene solution onto a glass substrate

key_findings.finding: The XRD pattern of the PeQD film shows peaks at 15.4°, 21.7°, 30.7°, 34.4°, 37.9°, and 44.0°, which are assigned to the (100), (110), (200), (201), (211), and (202) planes of the monoclinic phase.
The measured XRD pattern is well-fitted by the monoclinic crystalline structure, with no evidence of other crystalline phases.

scientific_interpretation.claim: The CsPbBr3 PeQDs synthesized and processed as described form a monoclinic crystalline phase, as evidenced by the XRD pattern and its fit.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: The caption and text explicitly state that the measured XRD pattern is fitted using the monoclinic structure, and the peak assignments match the monoclinic phase.

citations.evidence: the corresponding fit (black line) using the monoclinic crystalline structure

the measured diffraction peaks at 15.35°, 21.67°, 30.72°, 34.40°, 37.85°, and 44.02° in Figure 2d are due to diffraction from the (100), (110), (200), (201), (211), and (202) monoclinic crystal planes, respectively.

scientific_interpretation.claim: There is no evidence of phase impurities or secondary crystalline phases in the PeQD film based on the supplied XRD data.
scientific_interpretation.reasoning: Only peaks corresponding to the monoclinic phase are reported and fitted; no mention or evidence of additional peaks or phases is present.

citations.evidence: the corresponding fit (black line) using the monoclinic crystalline structure

limitations.claim: The XRD analysis is limited to a single sample type and processing condition; no comparison across different synthesis methods, compositions, or processing variables is possible.

citations.evidence: dry film of PeQDs deposited by drop-casting a PeQD-in-toluene solution onto a glass substrate

limitations.claim: No quantitative crystallite size or strain analysis is possible due to missing FWHM and peak width data.
The absence of XRD data for other phases, compositions, or device-relevant films limits the ability to generalize the structural findings to other forms or processing conditions.

citations.evidence: Only one sample type analyzed: dry film of PeQDs deposited by drop-casting
